$comment: Shared agent-eval registry. Each key is a pipeline agent; the value declares WHERE its gold eval set lives, HOW to score it (label | artifact), which field of a row feeds the model, and the pass threshold used as a CI gate. Adding a new agent (e.g. flow-author, mock-data-author) is a wiring change here plus, for artifact mode, an assertions/rubric block on each eval row — no harness redesign. All paths are relative to the repo root.

pt-classifier.notes: Booleans are the scored labels; outcome is derived from them via OUTCOME_BY_COMBO and reported as a secondary accuracy figure. Model pinned to haiku to match the pt-classifier template frontmatter. response_label_field names the sub-object of the model's returned JSON that holds the axes (pt-classifier's S4 contract nests them under 'expected'); omit or null it when an agent returns the axes at top level.

artifact_mode_example.$comment: Illustrative shape for a future artifact-producing agent (flow-author / mock-data-author). Not active. When wired, move it under agents{} and point eval_set at a jsonl whose rows carry {id, input, expected:{assertions:[...], rubric:'...'}}.
